data:text/html,<body><div style = "accent-color: %23E8E085; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 100vh;"><div><h1>TinySynth</h1><h2>Current pitch: <span id="current-pitch"></span> Hz</h2><p>Use the buttons to start and stop the sound, and the slider to change the pitch.</p></div><div class="controls"><button onclick="startSound()">Start sound</button><button onclick="stopSound()">Stop sound</button></div><div class="slider"><input id="pitch" type="range" min="100" max="1000" value="440" oninput="changePitch(), document.querySelector('%23current-pitch').innerHTML = this.value"><label for="pitch">Pitch</label></div><div class="slider"><input id="volume" type="range" min="0" max="1" step="0.01" value="0.5"><label for="volume">Volume</label></div></div><style>body{background:%23030164;color:%23E8E085;font-family:sans-serif}</style><script>const e=new AudioContext;document.querySelector("%23current-pitch").innerHTML=document.querySelector("%23pitch").value;const n=e.createGain();n.gain.value=.5,(void 0).connect(n),n.connect(e.destination);</script></body>
